match: a table without one cannot be addressed
why: Reachable from a caller and not from a model: an entity declaring no key is refused at the model stage (errors/026), so the keys this renderer receives are assembled by whoever calls it - the control plane does, per group. A table with no PRIMARY KEY cannot be addressed, migrated or verified, so emitting one would produce a group that looks placed and cannot be moved. `keys` in a case replaces the mapping derived from the model, which is the only way to reach this.
